mapper.sql: f.feed_id, f.user_id, f.content, f.images, f.related_product_id, f.visibility, f.like_count, f.comment_count, f.forward_count, f.hot_score, f.status, f.audit_status, f.audit_reason, f.original_feed_id, f.tenant_id, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.publish_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.nick_name AS user_nick_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM feed f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.feed_id = #{feedId} AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT , u.nick_name AS user_nick_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar, m.risk_level AS ai_risk_level, m.action AS ai_action, m.summary AS ai_summary, m.violations AS ai_violations FROM feed f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ai_moderation_log m ON m.log_id = ( SELECT ml.log_id FROM ai_moderation_log ml WHERE ml.biz_type = 'post' AND ml.biz_id = f.feed_id AND ml.action != 'error' ORDER BY ml.log_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE f.status = 'normal' AND f.audit_status = 'pending' ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT , u.nick_name AS user_nick_name, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM feed f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.status = 'normal' AND f.audit_status = 'approved' AND (f.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.images LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND f.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY f.publish_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed (user_id, content, images, related_product_id, visibility, status, audit_status, original_feed_id, publish_time, create_time, update_time , tenant_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{content}, #{images}, #{relatedProductId}, #{visibility}, #{status}, #{auditStatus}, #{originalFeedId}, #{publishTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} , #{tenantId})
mapper.update: UPDATE feed SET status = #{status}, audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_reason = #{auditReason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE feed SET status = 'deleted', update_time = NOW() WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE feed SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count + 1, 0), hot_score = (like_count + 1) * 1.0 + IFNULL(comment_count, 0) * 3.0 WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE feed SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0), hot_score = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) * 1.0 + IFNULL(comment_count, 0) * 3.0 WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE feed SET comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count - 1, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE feed SET comment_count = comment_count + 1, hot_score = like_count * 1.0 + comment_count * 1.0 WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE feed SET forward_count = forward_count + 1 WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT feed_id FROM feed_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_like WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT p.title AS related_product_title, p.cover AS related_product_cover, CAST(p.price AS SIGNED) AS related_product_price FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = #{relatedProductId} AND p.status = 'onsale' AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE feed SET hot_score = #{hotScore}, update_time = NOW() WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
